name: io.github.Kromatic-Innovation/krobot
description: Test demand and willingness to pay before you build; decide whether to keep funding, change or stop.

tools.description: Browse what Kromatic has when the user wants to see the options rather than answer a specific question: every downloadable template, the method pages of The Real Startup Book, Kromatic's other MCP servers (Fermi for estimates, Neumann for Monte Carlo simulation) or the agent skills list.
tools.name: list_resources
tools.title: List resources

tools.description: Find the Kromatic method, example or template that fits the user's situation, such as checking demand for a feature before building it, testing whether people will pay a given price, getting first paying commitments before launch, or deciding whether to keep funding a project.
tools.name: search_resources
tools.title: Search resources

tools.description: Read a whole Kromatic page when an excerpt is not enough: a method's steps, thresholds, costs, examples and AI prompts, a blog post, a lesson, or what a template contains.
tools.name: read_resource
tools.title: Read resource

tools.description: Get the actual files of a Kromatic template or worksheet, such as the Pivot or Persevere template, when the user wants to fill it in or share it.
tools.name: download_resource
tools.title: Download resource

tools.description: Send a bug report, feature request or comment about Krobot to the Kromatic team by email when the user asks you to.
tools.name: feedback
tools.title: Send feedback
